description: Investigates the H_4(q) ↔ H_2(q) cross-algebra bridge (Path D from the Higgs residual audit). Tabulates Wedderburn dimensions, branching multiplicities for S_2 ↪ S_3 ↪ S_4, and searches for a structural multiplicative factor that closes the ~0.5% residual without fitting.
fundamental_obstruction: Higgs prediction consistency requires m_W/m_Z = P_2/P_3 (from PR #1159 theorem higgs_W_Z_predictions_consistent_hypothesis). Observed m_W/m_Z = 0.881469; predicted P_2/P_3 = 0.891276; relative gap = -1.1003%. This ~1.1% gap IS the W/Z anchor asymmetry seen as the Higgs residual — reflecting SM electroweak mixing not in the H_2(q) trace formula.
verdict: NO structural cross-algebra factor within 0.5% of required; Path D as a SINGLE multiplicative bridge FAILS. The W/Z anchor asymmetry IS the residual; closure requires Path A (substrate v derivation, policy-declined) or Path B (Yekutieli MI k=3 tessellation, ~1 month research).
